I replied to Ilse's message in #north-team: "Noted, Ilse. You're on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. Safe travels. Tag me if you'd like anything handled or summarised while you're out."

Her message was just a note that she'd be away, not a request, so I didn't do anything else. Before replying, I checked the channel's recent messages and found nothing waiting on her.
